POST /api/v1/inbox/extract: Fetch a URL and return a preview. Follow with POST /api/v1/inbox using the preview fields.
POST /api/v1/inbox: Capture an item. `source` defaults to `manual`. Optional header `Idempotency-Key` (64 hex chars); required when `source` is `extension`.
POST /api/v1/tasks: Create a task. `listId` must be a user or inbox list UUID, not a `smart:*` id. Call GET /api/v1/lists first.
POST /api/v1/tasks/from-text: Parse natural language into a task using the account LLM settings.
GET /api/v1/tasks: List tasks in a list. `listId` may be a UUID or `smart:today` / `smart:inbox` / `smart:upcoming` / `smart:someday` / `smart:done`.
GET /api/v1/reports/current: Get or create the report for the period containing `at` (defaults to now).
POST /api/v1/tokens: Create a personal access token. The `token` field is returned once.
GET /api/v1/tokens/:id/access: Call log for one token, newest first, retained 30 days.
